name: Jason Forbus
summary: Current Physics Ph.D. Student at the University of Virginia. Several years experience in condensed matter research. Interested in signal processing and data analysis roles.

work_experience.summary: Conducted research on ultrawide bandgap semiconductors using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) investigating defect mechanisms and material properties. Published andpresented research findings (see Google Scholar)
highlights: PI: Dr. Mary Ellen Zvanut mezvanut@uab.edu

work_experience.summary: Developed and maintained database systems using SQL for a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Contributed to backend and web development using .NET andC#. Collaborated with team using version control and project tracking tools.
